capabilities: create custom commands shown in the command palette
open or create notes at paths with date placeholders and templates
insert text snippets with date/time placeholders at the cursor
chain multiple commands into a sequence
extras: Requires Obsidian v0.15.0 or above; works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian's command palette only offers fixed built-in commands, so users cannot define their own parameterized commands for recurring note actions.
summary: Command builder that lets users define custom palette commands to open, create, or insert into notes, or run command sequences.
